text.aria-label: Title text 'The gate's controls recovered the injected signal too, and ENC-r barely recovered it'

g.text: The gate's controls recovered the injected signal too, and ENC-r barely recovered it

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'A known function of the patch was added to the target on the 2024-04 to 2025-06 fitting year (never the scored year). Bar: share of the gain an exact recovery would give, at the five decision substations. Dashed lines: the 50% an encoder must reach and the 20% a control must stay under. Controls ENC-c0 and ENC-cpt cannot see the injected signal in principle and should be near zero.'
